main.description: An item kept for later (a star). Identified by its permalink; feedUrl and entryId help a reader match it to a cached item.

title.description: Display title at the time it was saved.

feedUrl.description: The feed the item came from. A soft reference: it may outlive the subscription.

entryId.description: The item id, by the same rule as readState ids (see docs/lexicon.md).
